extra-projects.name: Hizero Portugal
extra-projects.description: Led the design and development of the Hizero Portugal website, combining UI/UX work in Figma with a custom WordPress implementation. Extended core functionality through PHP and JavaScript, and optimized frontend performance using SASS, Bootstrap, and asset pipelines with Gulp. Version control and collaboration managed via Git and GitHub.

extra-projects.name: Marta e Nuno Wedding Website
extra-projects.description: End-to-end creation of a modern, responsive wedding website for Marta and Nuno, from UI/UX design (with some inputs from the client) to development in Next.js. The platform includes a real-time RSVP system powered by Supabase and is optimized for performance through deployment on Vercel.

extra-projects.name: Mediportela
extra-projects.description: The client needed a website created from scratch, so that workers could insert house advertisements. It is also possible for the end user to contact the company directly when in a home item via a form. Wordpress configured on the server by me. And the design too!

extra-projects.name: App Despesas (Expenses App)
extra-projects.description: This idea came up after I noticed that Splitwise was now paid for, so I decided to look for a way to do this completely free, it was then that I discovered Google's Firebase. I had a very fixed idea of ​​using the React framework. I created a database model and created the various components to be able to connect to these tables. And this was the end result.

extra-projects.name: To Do List
extra-projects.description: A streamlined to-do list app developed from scratch, showcasing proficiency in React and integrating Recoil for efficient state management. Built with Vite and styled using Tailwind CSS for a modern, responsive design.
